partnerships

ana_p: Quick sync — need to finalize AWS/GCP/Azure listing preflight: IPR flags, trial SKU mapping, billing contact. Who can own legal signoff by EOD Fri? cc: @karen_legal @mike_product
chris_ops: I can own network/KMS creds. Will need the publisher IAM list from partnerships. @ana_p send manifest when ready.
karen_legal: I can review EULA/license. Need final packaging doc + list of restricted countries. Please get that to me by Thu 3pm.
mike_product: I'll consolidate packaging and trial SKU mapping. Do we want 14-day trial or a metered free tier? Also need any usage cap expectations.
ana_p: Sorry typo — meant ana_p: 14-day trial preferred. @chris_ops can you confirm whether vendor trial entitlements map to our trial SKU?
chris_ops: Yes, but Azure private offer requires a different entitlement_id. I'll add mapping in the manifest. snippet:
```
azure_offer: "privateOffer-xxx"
trial_sku: "trial-14d"
entitlement_mapping: { "azure": "ent-az-123" }
```
mike_product: :thumbsup: will wire into product manifest and flag any UX changes.
onboard-bot: Reminder — marketplace compliance checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/checklist
ana_p: (fixing earlier) ana_p: Thanks — I'll collate everything and circulate a final checklist. Next check-in Thu 4pm. :party_parrot:
